what: While the section stays pinned to the screen and (item count × 100%) scrolls by, items like Services are advanced one at a time — the left stack of titles moves up by the passed title (title height + 15px above and below), the passed item’s body collapses to height 0 and transparent, and the current item’s body expands to a height of screen height − header − title stack. On the right, the next photo plate rises from 100% below and covers the previous one. Item t sits at timeline position 1 + 1.2(t−1) with length 1, tied directly to scroll. Upcoming item titles are a faded color (.5s cubic-bezier(.76,.015,.41,1)), passed ones get is-passed, the current one is-on, and upcoming ones is-upcoming

options.head: Header selector — its height is subtracted from the body height to be unfolded
options.top: Height to subtract when there is no head selector (px), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=item]·[data-fx-part=title]: Item · its title · body that collapses and expands
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Right photo panel (one per item, stacked)
